description: The sliding-tile game in the panel, played from the keyboard. The board and your best score are kept across restarts.
author: pal

settings.label: Undo
settings.text: U takes the last move back
settings.description: One move only; taking a win back restores the banner. Off, the key does nothing and the move is not listed.

store.tagline: 2048 in the panel, keyboard only; the board persists
features: Arrows or `hjkl` slide the tiles; the score sits in the title
The classic rules: equal tiles merge once per move, a new 2 or 4 lands after every move
Tiles slide, merge and pop in, coloured by value
`U` takes a move back (a setting); `N` starts over, asking first mid-game
Keep going past 2048, or start a new game
Leave with `escape` any time; the board, score and best score are there when you come back

screenshots.caption: Mid-game: the score, the best and the move count above the board, the keys under it
The first 2048: keep going or start over
Game over: no move left, the score, Enter for a new game

actions.title: Up, Down, Left, Right
actions.description: Slide every tile that way; equal neighbours merge. `k`, `j`, `h`, `l` too.

actions.title: Undo the last move
actions.description: One move back, when the `undo` setting is on.

actions.title: New game
actions.description: A fresh board; asks first mid-game, where Enter is this too. The best score is kept.

actions.title: Keep going
actions.description: After the first 2048, play on for a higher tile.

2048.description: The board. Escape leaves mid-game; it is there when you come back.

keys.title: Move (also down, left, right, and hjkl)
New game (asks mid-game); Keep going after the first 2048
